about: Known contradictions, counted per coherency check (src/core/08-coherency-checks), that round 2 must remove. Counts may only shrink: tests/suites/coherency.test.mjs fails in CI when a 'quick' count rises, tools/coherency.mjs --baseline=nightly fails the nightly run when a 'nightly' count rises. Lower a count when a step removes contradictions (node tools/coherency.mjs --baseline=<section> --write); never raise one without a line in docs/DECISIONS.md. Empty when round 2 ends (CRITIQUE A3a). Owners: dead and child holders A2, councils of new realms A2, styled offices A2 and C6.
